title: lennrt/palomar-formalizations
summary: Lean formalization of the paper's finite skew-symmetric path instance, exact prefix-deletion completion oracle, deterministic oracle-pruned DFS, correctness and duplicate-freedom, and an executable DFS event trace whose extracted first-output, inter-output, post-output, and no-output work intervals satisfy the paper-level depth/LCP bounds.

formalizes.title: Polynomial-Delay Enumeration of Fixed-Endpoint Vertex-Regular Paths in Skew-Symmetric Digraphs

review.reason: Lean formalization of a deterministic pruned DFS for skew-symmetric paths with work-bound analysis.
